Baeble Music — September 27, 2013

Let Har Mar Superstar, Caveman, and More Save Your Life

By Matt Howard · Baeble Music

Elton John's Captain Fantastic and the Brown Dirt Cowboy classic "Someone Saved My Life Tonight" has perhaps the most epic, never-ending conclusion. But how long does the "someone saved, someone saved...TONIGHT!" really last? According to Har Mar Superstar, members of Caveman, Sinkane, and French Kicks, it lasts a little longer than 12 minutes.

See if you can sit through the entire 12 minutes of the video that was shot in a single take.
